releaseNotes: When a licence record may be your business but the evidence is mixed, AIReady now shows it with its evidence and asks you once; your answer is kept. On AIReady Advanced, ask what AI search engines (the web-search tools AI agents use) find for your business, and start a new check once a day. AIReady now connects as one app with every tool: no separate "AIReady Advanced" connection to add.

migrations.description: The ChatGPT update archive also carries harmless replacements for files that older versions installed and the host cannot delete (the retired guide-aiready skill and old eval files).
